summary: Tested the Rabobank XS1002121454 follow-up end-to-end: a new backend pytest file (12/12 passed, run twice) plus Playwright UI runs for customer and admin. 1) No binding price: the card shows bond-request-purchase + 'Kaufangebot anfordern'; a 1000 € offer request returns 201 with a success toast. /orders/check returns 409 'kein verbindlicher Kaufkurs'. 2) With the binding price 109.10 (TEST Vorschau, +2h), the API and the dialog both show 37 Stk / 925,00 € Nennwert / Kaufbetrag 1.009,18 € / Gebühren 0,00 € / Gesamt 1.009,18 € with adjusted_to_minimum=true, and the bond-buy-minimum text says 'Mindestanlage 1.000,00 € (Kaufbetrag) · mindestens 37 Stk.'. With min_order_basis 'nominal' it shows 40 Stk / 1.000,00 € / 1.091,00 €. Switching back to 'purchase' through the admin edit modal (select bond-admin-field-min_order_basis) saves and persists, and valid_until is kept. 3) Insufficient funds (300 €): bond-buy-insufficient + bond-buy-request-advice are shown and there is no confirm button. Opening /orders/check (also repeatedly) creates no IBP entry. Clicking advice -> POST /orders 402, toast and message with the exact required text, button changes to 'Schließen', and exactly 1 insufficient_buying_power_events entry exists. 4) With a temporary 3500 € deposit, confirming creates an awaiting_bank order. 1.009,18 € is reserved (available 3800 -> 2790.82), balance is unchanged, there is no ledger debit and no bond_positions entry. 5) Duplicate: reopening with the same amount shows bond-buy-duplicate-hint with the open order listed and bond-buy-confirm disabled; the API returns 409 DUPLICATE_ORDER, also with confirm_additional=true. 2000 € shows bond-buy-confirm-additional with confirm disabled until it is ticked; the API returns 409 OPEN_ORDER_EXISTS without it and 201 with it (73 Stk / 1825 / 1991.08). 6) Bank flow: execute on awaiting_bank -> 409 REQUEST_BAD_STATUS; bank-submit -> bank_submitted (still duplicate-blocked); execute (API and admin UI modal bond-execute-*) -> 200 executed. Result: exactly 1 bond_positions entry (nominal 925, cost_basis 1009.18) and exactly 1 settled bond_purchase debit of 1009.18 (re-execute is idempotent, no second debit). Balance dropped by 1009.18, available was unchanged by the execution (reservation released), and the customer's /api/portfolio/bond-positions shows the position. After the execution and an admin cancel of the 2000 order, the same 1000 € purchase is possible again (no open-orders block, confirm enabled, API 201). 7) Price monitoring: valid_until +3h -> price-alerts status 'expiring', bond-price-alerts banner on /admin/bond-catalog ('läuft ab am ...'), counts.bond_price_alerts=1. Valid_until in the past -> status 'expired' and the banner says 'abgelaufen seit ...'. The admin badge shows 'Kein ausführbarer Kurs', the customer card shows 'Kaufangebot anfordern' and /orders/check returns 409. If the price expires while the dialog is open, confirm gives 409, the dialog closes and an error toast appears. Amount 999 -> 400 Mindestanlage. Auth: bcrypt $2b$, access/refresh cookies HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None, CORS uses the explicit origin with credentials. CLEANUP done and verified: Rabobank kaufkurs/kaufkurs_art/kaufkurs_quelle/kaufkurs_quoted_at/kaufkurs_valid_until = null, min_order_basis='purchase', requests_enabled/orders_enabled=true. All test bond_purchase_requests, their audit_log rows, bond_executions, bond_positions, cash_ledger rows (deposits + bond debits), IBP events and 4 'bond_executed' customer notifications (stock_alert_notifications) are deleted. tester@mester.de is back to 45 ledger rows, cash 300.00/300.00, 0 requests, 0 IBP, 0 positions, 0 executions.

minor.issue: kaufkurs* fields count as PRICE_FIELDS, so every binding-price edit (and every modal save, since datetime-local drops the seconds and valid_until always 'changes') bumps price_updated_at and writes a bond_price_history row. The customer card shows that timestamp as 'Referenzkurs ... erfasst 05.11.2026, 13:2x' for the unchanged historical reference price 108,75 %, so the reference value looks freshly captured. The Rabobank price_updated_at now has the test time instead of the seed time (2026-11-05 09:30:53 UTC). I left it as is and did not restore it, and I also left the test audit/price-history rows (same as iteration_117).
Counts filter is_available=true, but price-alerts doesn't. For a hidden bond with an expired binding price, the banner lists it while the badge count doesn't include it.

Serialised only by an in-process asyncio.Lock per user. This works with the current --workers 1, but it isn't safe with several workers or pods. There is no unique index for open direct orders (user, bond, nominal).

execute_bond_request creates a customer 'bond_executed' notification in stock_alert_notifications. This is fine functionally, but earlier regression cleanups (iter117 file) didn't remove it. The new test file now does.

ui_bugs.issue: When the price expires while the dialog is open, the user gets the same error toast twice (once from the 409 and once from the failing refetch). The catalog isn't reloaded, so the card keeps showing 'Jetzt kaufen' until a page reload.

issues: 'Datum der Bankbestätigung' (bond-execute-bank-date) uses the native <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy in an en browser) instead of the shadcn calendar/date picker.

The Volumen column shows the customer's amount_eur (1.000 €) for direct orders, not the reserved total (1.009,18 €) or the nominal. That's confusing for the 2000 € order (nominal 1.825, reserved 1.991,08).

action_items: Optional: exclude kaufkurs* fields from bumping price_updated_at (or keep a separate kaufkurs_updated_at) so the customer-facing reference-price 'erfasst' stamp stays correct
Optional: align the is_available filter between /admin/notifications/counts bond_price_alerts and /admin/bonds/price-alerts
Optional: BondBuyDialog: on a 409 refetch failure show one toast only and refresh the catalog (or pass a callback) so the card switches to 'Kaufangebot anfordern' without a reload
Optional: replace the native date input in the execute modal with the shadcn date picker
critical_code_review_comments: routes/bond_requests.py is 825 lines: split the admin and direct-order endpoints into their own modules
BondBuyDialog/BondPriceAlerts/AnleihenKaufenPage use relative fetch('/api/...') rather than REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. It works through the ingress but doesn't follow the convention.

The execute saga checks balance (not available) against the total. With several open reservations, an admin executing one order with a higher nominal/price than reserved could push available negative. There is no check that the executed total is <= reserved_cash.

/api/portfolio/bond-positions returns avg_cost 0.0 for the executed bond (cost_basis 1009.18 and kaufkurs 109.1 are correct), and aktueller_kurs falls back to the purchase price (kurs_is_fallback true). Check whether the UI uses avg_cost.
